defs.def: to ask for a seat, table, room, etc. to be available for you or sb else at a future time 预订，预约（座位、席位、房间等）

ex.s: It reserves seats for the seniors.
Reserve your spot before availability — the cherry blossoms — disappear!
ex.t: 华盛顿特区樱花自行车之旅

defs.def: to keep sth for sb/sth, so that it cannot be used by any other person or for any other reason 保留；预留

ex.s: Some instructors choose to put previous test papers on library reserve,  making them available to all students.
ex.t: 一些教师选择把往年试卷放在图书馆 reserve，让所有学生都能借阅。

defs.def: to have or keep a particular power 拥有，保持，保留（某种权利）
a supply of sth that is available to be used in the future or when it is needed 储备（量）；贮藏（量）

ex.s: Having created nine such ice reserves, Norphel calculates that he has stored about 200, 000 m3 of water.
ex.t: 在建立了9个这样的冰储量之后，诺尔菲尔计算出他储存了大约200,000立方米的水。

ex.s: Climate change is a continuing process, so Norphel’s ice reserves will not last forever.
ex.t: 气候变化是一个持续的过程，所以诺费尔的冰储备不会永远持续下去。

defs.def: a piece of land that is a protected area for animals, plants, etc. （动植物）保护区；自然保护区

ex.s: When the tiny creature arrived on January 31, she became the 40th black rhino to be born at the reserve.
ex.t: 当这个小家伙1月31日到来时，它成为了保护区出生的第40头黑犀牛。

ex.s: His mother, grandmother and great grandmother were all born at the reserve and still live there.
ex.t: 它的母亲、祖母和曾祖母都出生在保护区并且仍然生活在那里。

ex.s: They were brought to the reserve young
ex.t: 她们年轻时被带到保护区

ex.s: What can be inferred about Porn Lympne Reserve?
ex.t: 关于Port Lympne保护区能推断出什么？

ex.s: Lin Feng: Well, SNNR was established in 2000 and is the highest and second largest nature reserve in China.
ex.t: 林峰：嗯，神农架自然保护区成立于 2000 年，是中国海拔最高、面积第二大的自然保护区。

ex.s: As you can probably guess, I take care of the pandas living in Sichuan’s Wolong National Nature Reserve.
ex.t: 你们大概可以猜到，我照顾的是生活在四川卧龙国家级自然保护区的大熊猫。

ex.s: Even after Macquarie Island became an official nature reserve in the 1970s, the rabbits remained out of control.
ex.t: 即使在麦夸里岛于1970年代成为官方自然保护区之后，野兔仍然处于失控状态。

ex.s: The adorable female calf is the second black rhino born this year at the reserve, but it is too early to tell if the calves will make good candidates to be returned to protected areas of the wild.
ex.t: 这只可爱的雌性幼崽是今年该保护区出生的第二头黑犀牛，但现在判断这些幼崽是否适合被放归野外保护区还为时过早。

ex.s: It is home to over one hundred nature reserves and many rare species of animals and plants.
ex.t: 它是超过一百个自然保护区和许多珍稀动植物物种的家园。

defs.def: the quality that sb has when they do not talk easily to other people about their ideas, feelings, etc. 内向；寡言少语；矜持
a feeling that you do not want to accept or agree to sth, etc. until you are quite sure that it is all right to do so 谨慎；保留
an extra player who plays in a team when one of the other players is injured or not available to play 替补队员；后备队员
a team that is below the level of the main team 替补队；预备队；后备队
an extra military force, etc. that is not part of a country's regular forces, but is available to be used when needed 预备役部队；后备部队
the lowest price that sb will accept for sth, especially sth that is sold at an auction （尤指拍卖中的）底价，最低价
